title: Red Hat Security Advisory: oci-delta security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This advisory addresses security vulnerabilities in the oci-delta tool used on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 systems. The vulnerabilities include denial of service issues in Go libraries encoding/asn1 (CVE-2026-33818) and crypto/tls (CVE-2026-97031). The update to oci-delta version 0.3.1 includes fixes for these issues along with bug fixes and enhancements. The vulnerabilities could cause denial of service via excessive recursion or malformed TLS extensions. Red Hat has released patched packages for multiple architectures.
